title: Tech Note: Using RegEx “Lookarounds” with 4D Match regex
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Match regex command (4D's regular expression engine)
Nested and combined lookaround patterns with conditionals

historical_commentary.text: Regular expression syntax and lookaround semantics are a language-level standard that has not changed, so this note's core content (how lookaround assertions work and how to write them) is genuinely timeless and remains directly usable with 4D's Match regex command today.
